name: Burgenland
summary: Two horizontal bands of red over gold. The colours come from the state arms, which combine the arms of the medieval Counts of Mattersdorf-Forchtenstein and Güssing.
origin: Burgenland, previously part of Hungary, joined Austria in 1921 after the First World War. Its arms and colours were adopted in 1922.
facts: It is Austria's youngest and easternmost state.
The state flag adds a red eagle on gold.
clues: Red over gold, two horizontal bands.
Austria's youngest state, formerly part of Hungary.
